lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 1
lessons.subtitle: Welcome!

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hi! Are you Anna?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes! Hi there! Are you Pete?

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I am Pete.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let's try that again. I'm Anna. Nice to meet you.
dialogue.zh: 我们再试一次。我是安娜。很高兴认识你。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I'm Pete. "Anna" Is that A-N-A?
dialogue.zh: 我是皮特。“安娜”是拼成 A-N-A 吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. A-N-N-A

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Well, Anna with two "n's" ... Welcome to ... 1400 Irving Street!
dialogue.zh: 好的，有两个 n 的安娜……欢迎来到……欧文街 1400 号！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: My new apartment! Yes!

quiz.prompt: Who greets Anna first?
How do you spell Anna's name?
Where is Anna's new apartment?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 2
lessons.subtitle: Hello, I'm Anna!

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Hey, Pete! Who’s your friend?

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: She is Anna. She is new to D.C.
dialogue.zh: 她是安娜。她刚到华盛顿特区。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Where are you from?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am from a small town.

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Well, welcome to D.C.
dialogue.zh: 好的，欢迎来到华盛顿特区。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: I am Jonathan. I am in apartment B4.
dialogue.zh: 我是乔纳森。我住在 B4 公寓。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am in apartment C2. Marsha is my roommate.
dialogue.zh: 我住在 C2 公寓。玛莎是我的室友。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: I know Marsha. She is nice.

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: And I am in Apartment D7. I have to go now.
dialogue.zh: 我住在 D7 公寓。我现在得走了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh!

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Remember to call Marsha at work. Tell her you’re here.
dialogue.zh: 记得给上班的玛莎打电话。告诉她你到了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Right, thanks, Pete. Nice to meet you!
dialogue.zh: 好的，谢谢，皮特。很高兴认识你！

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: You too, Bye.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Apartment C2, here I come!

quiz.prompt: Where is Anna from?
Who lives in apartment B4?
Who is Marsha?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 3
lessons.subtitle: I'm Here!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am in my new apartment! Great!
dialogue.zh: 我在我的新公寓里了！太好了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I live with Marsha. We’re roommates.
dialogue.zh: 我和玛莎住在一起。我们是室友。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I want to cook dinner. Oh! Hmmm. Is there a supermarket near here?
dialogue.zh: 我想做晚饭。哦！嗯……这附近有超市吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha knows. Marsha's work number is 555-8986.
dialogue.zh: 玛莎知道。玛莎上班的电话是 555-8986。

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: Hello.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello. Is this Marsha? It is Anna.
dialogue.zh: 你好。是玛莎吗？我是安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: I am sorry. You have the wrong number.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. Is this 555-8986?

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: No. This is 555-8689.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. Excuse me!

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: Okay. 'Bye.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: One more time. 555-8986. Please be Marsha.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Hello. This is Marsha.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, Marsha. I want to cook dinner.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Excuse me? Anna? Is that you?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, yes. I am here!

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Good. You are there.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I want to find a supermarket.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Oh, okay. The supermarket is at 1500 Irving Street. It is near the apartment.
dialogue.zh: 哦，好的。超市在欧文街 1500 号。就在公寓附近。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great! Goodbye!

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Goodbye, Anna.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There is a big supermarket on our street. And Marsha says I am a good cook! Until next time! Bye!
dialogue.zh: 我们这条街上有一家很大的超市。玛莎还说我很会做饭！下次见！再见！

quiz.prompt: What does Anna say about Marsha?
Why does the man say he is sorry?
What does Marsha say about the supermarket?
choices: It is at 1500 Irving Street, near the apartment

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 4
lessons.subtitle: What Is It?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, hi! Hi, we are here!

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna! Hi, Marsha!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi!

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: How are you two?

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I am great!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You know, Pete, I am new to D.C. The city is big.
dialogue.zh: 你知道的，皮特，我刚到华盛顿特区。这座城市很大。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Yeah. But you learn a little more every day. How's the new apartment?
dialogue.zh: 是啊。不过你每天都会多学一点。新公寓怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The new apartment is great! Let's get coffee!
dialogue.zh: 新公寓很棒！我们去喝咖啡吧！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, do you have a pen?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. I have a pen in my bag.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have a …

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: It is not a pen. It is a book. It is a big book.
dialogue.zh: 那不是笔。那是一本书。一本很大的书。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. Yes it is, Pete. I know I have a pen, though…
dialogue.zh: 对。是的，皮特。不过我知道我有一支笔……

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have a ....

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: It is not a pen, Anna ... a toy?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have a ....

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: And it is a pillow!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, Marsha, I know I have a pen.
dialogue.zh: 皮特，玛莎，我知道我有一支笔。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, it is a map.

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Why do you have a map of the world?
dialogue.zh: 你为什么带着一张世界地图？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, Marsha. Now I know I have a pen.
dialogue.zh: 皮特，玛莎。现在我知道我有一支笔了。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: And now you have a lamp.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have a pen! Let’s get coffee!
dialogue.zh: 我有笔了！我们去喝咖啡吧！

quiz.prompt: What does Marsha ask Anna for?
What does Pete say about the first thing from Anna's bag?
choices: It is a book. It is a big book

quiz.prompt: What does Anna finally find?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 5
lessons.subtitle: Where Are You?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, everyone! Today my friend Marsha is at her friend's house.
dialogue.zh: 大家好！今天我的朋友玛莎在她朋友家里。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: She says it is beautiful. I want to see this house! Here we are!
dialogue.zh: 她说那房子很漂亮。我想去看看！我们到了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, I am in the kitchen! It is a beautiful kitchen!
dialogue.zh: 玛莎，我在厨房里！这厨房很漂亮！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: It is beautiful. We cook in the kitchen.
dialogue.zh: 是很漂亮。我们在厨房做饭。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I eat in the kitchen.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: We relax in the living room.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I relax in the living room. Marsha, let’s go upstairs!
dialogue.zh: 我在客厅休息。玛莎，我们上楼吧！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna? Where are you?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, I am in the bathroom! I wash in the bathroom.
dialogue.zh: 玛莎，我在浴室里！我在浴室洗澡。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I am in the bedroom. We sleep in the bedroom.
dialogue.zh: 我在卧室里。我们在卧室睡觉。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I sleep in the bedroom!

quiz.prompt: Where is Marsha today?
Where do they cook?
Where is Anna when Marsha asks, "Where are you?"

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 6
lessons.subtitle: Where Is the Gym?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi there! I’m Anna and I live in Washington, D.C.
dialogue.zh: 大家好！我是安娜，住在华盛顿特区。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Every day I learn more about this great city. People in Washington like to work out!
dialogue.zh: 我每天都对这座很棒的城市了解得更多。华盛顿的人喜欢锻炼！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, hi, Pete. How’s it going?

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna. It’s going great. How’s it going with you?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Things are awesome! Pete, I want to work out. Where is the gym?
dialogue.zh: 棒极了！皮特，我想去锻炼。健身房在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: The gym is across from the lounge. It’s next to the mailroom. Go that way.
dialogue.zh: 健身房在休息厅对面。就在收发室旁边。走那边。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Pete!

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No, Anna! Not that way! Go that way!
dialogue.zh: 不，安娜！不是那边！走这边！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, Pete. This is not the gym.

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: That’s right, Anna. This is the mailroom.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The gym is across from … what?

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: The gym is across from the lounge.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Across from the lounge. Right. Thanks!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete! This is not the gym!

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: The gym is across from the lounge. It is behind the lobby.
dialogue.zh: 健身房在休息厅对面。它在大堂后面。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Right. Right. See you.

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: See you, Anna!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is not the gym. This is a parking garage.
dialogue.zh: 这不是健身房。这是停车场。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is not a gym. This is a rooftop.
dialogue.zh: 这不是健身房。这是屋顶。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I want to work out too! Join me!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m good.

quiz.prompt: What does Anna want to do?
Where is the gym?
choices: Across from the lounge, next to the mailroom

quiz.prompt: What does Pete say when Anna finds the gym?
choices: I want to work out too! Join me!

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 7
lessons.subtitle: What Are You Doing?

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Come in.

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Well, Anna, welcome.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: I am your boss, Caty Weaver. But, please call me Caty.
dialogue.zh: 我是你的老板，凯蒂·韦弗。不过，请叫我凯蒂。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you, Ms. Weaver.

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Just Caty.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure thing, Ms. Weaver.

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Okay then. Are you excited?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, I am excited!

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: So sorry, but I am busy. Please meet your co-workers. But remember, they are busy working.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我很忙。去见见你的同事吧。不过记住，他们正在忙着工作。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi there! I’m Anna.

dialogue.speaker: Anne
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna. I’m Anne.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you. What are you doing?
dialogue.zh: 很高兴认识你。你在做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anne
dialogue.en: Um, I’m writing.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You are writing! You are writing a lot!
dialogue.zh: 你在写东西！你写得真多！

dialogue.speaker: Anne
dialogue.en: No! No! That's okay.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am sorry!

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: and people all around the world are waiting to hear news about the next president…
dialogue.zh: 全世界的人都在等待下一位总统的消息……

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Jonathan, hi! Remember me? I live in your building.
dialogue.zh: 乔纳森，嗨！还记得我吗？我住在你那栋楼里。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: I am doing my show!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, sorry. Are you recording?

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Yes! And, now I have to record again!
dialogue.zh: 是的！现在我又得重新录一遍！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sorry. Have a good show.

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: The word of the day is social.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you! What are you doing?
dialogue.zh: 很高兴认识你！你在做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: I’m reading.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Are you reading the news?

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: No, I’m reading for my show.
dialogue.zh: 不是，我在为我的节目读稿。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Anna! Hi! What’re you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am bothering people, Ms. Weaver.
dialogue.zh: 我在打扰别人，韦弗女士。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Let’s go to my office and talk.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I like to talk with you, Ms. Weaver.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢和您聊天，韦弗女士。

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 8
lessons.subtitle: Are You Busy?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, everyone. Here I am at my new job!
dialogue.zh: 大家好。我现在在新工作的地方！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yesterday at my first day of work … Well, let’s not talk about yesterday. Today is a new day!
dialogue.zh: 昨天是我上班的第一天……算了，我们别提昨天了。今天是新的一天！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today I want to apologize to my co-workers.
dialogue.zh: 今天我想向同事们道歉。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Anne. Are you busy?

dialogue.speaker: Anne
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna. Yes. At 10 a.m. I am writing. Every day I do my morning show. Sorry!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜。是的。上午 10 点我在写稿。我每天都做早间节目。抱歉！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay. See you later, maybe.

dialogue.speaker: Anne
dialogue.en: Maybe I’ll see you later.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Jonathan. Are you busy?

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Yes, I’m busy. When the studio light is on, I am recording my evening show.
dialogue.zh: 是的，我很忙。演播室的灯亮着的时候，我在录晚间节目。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Right. Sorry about yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: No worries.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: May I see the studio?

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Um, maybe another time? Right now I am busy.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Amelia! Are you busy?

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: I’m a little busy.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I want to say I’m sorry for yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 我想为昨天的事说对不起。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: It’s okay, Anna. Come by this afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 没关系，安娜。今天下午再来。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Are you busy?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, Ms. Weaver. I am busy.

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: My office. 5:00 p.m.
dialogue.zh: 来我办公室。下午 5 点。

dialogue.speaker: Co-Workers
dialogue.en: Surprise!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: A party! Awesome! And I still have my job! Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 派对！太棒了！而且我还保住了工作！下次见！

What does Anne do at 10 a.m. every day?
choices: She is writing for her morning show
She is recording her evening show

quiz.prompt: What happens in Caty's office at 5:00 p.m.?
choices: The co-workers have a surprise party

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 9
lessons.subtitle: Is It Cold?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, hi, everyone! Here in Washington, DC, the weather changes often.
dialogue.zh: 哦，大家好！在华盛顿特区，天气常常变化。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: One day is cold and windy. But the next day is warm and sunny! So, every day I check the forecast.
dialogue.zh: 有一天又冷又刮风。可第二天又暖和又晴朗！所以我每天都看天气预报。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, Phone? What is today’s temperature?
dialogue.zh: 喂，手机？今天气温是多少？

dialogue.speaker: Phone
dialogue.en: Today it is 18 degrees ...

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Eighteen degrees! That is cold!

dialogue.speaker: Phone
dialogue.en: … eighteen degrees Celsius.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, Celsius. That is 65 degrees Fahrenheit. That’s warm.
dialogue.zh: 哦，是摄氏度。那是华氏 65 度。那很暖和。

dialogue.speaker: Phone
dialogue.en: Yes, Anna. It is warm.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Excuse me, Phone. Is it windy today?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，手机。今天刮风吗？

dialogue.speaker: Phone
dialogue.en: No, it is not windy today.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Is it sunny today?

dialogue.speaker: Phone
dialogue.en: Yes, Anna. It is sunny.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Is it snowy today?

dialogue.speaker: Phone
dialogue.en: No, Anna. It is not snowy.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today the weather is warm and sunny -- great for seeing Washington, D.C.
dialogue.zh: 今天天气暖和又晴朗——很适合游览华盛顿特区。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Phone! It is not warm and sunny! It is cold and windy and snowy!
dialogue.zh: 手机！今天并不暖和晴朗！又冷，又刮风，还下雪！

dialogue.speaker: Phone
dialogue.en: Anna, it is not cold, windy, or snowy. It is warm and sunny … in Mexico City, Mexico.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，并不冷，也不刮风，更不下雪。暖和又晴朗的是……墨西哥的墨西哥城。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. I see. Mexico.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Washington weather changes often. Remember to check the forecast -- the right forecast.
dialogue.zh: 华盛顿的天气常常变化。记得看天气预报——要看正确的预报。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time!

quiz.prompt: What is 18 degrees Celsius in Fahrenheit?
What does the phone first say about the weather?
Where is the warm, sunny weather?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 10
lessons.subtitle: Come Over to My Place

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi! Today, my friend Ashley, is coming over. I am showing her my new apartment!
dialogue.zh: 嗨！今天我的朋友阿什莉要来。我要带她看看我的新公寓！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh! That’s Ashley calling.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi Ashley!

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Hi Anna! I’m coming to your apartment. Where is your apartment?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜！我正去你的公寓。你的公寓在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: My apartment is near the Columbia Heights Metro.
dialogue.zh: 我的公寓在哥伦比亚高地地铁站附近。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: It is near the Columbia Heights Metro?
dialogue.zh: 是在哥伦比亚高地地铁站附近吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. Exit the Metro and turn right. Then at the bus station turn left. Then walk straight ahead.
dialogue.zh: 对。出地铁后向右转。然后在公交站向左转。接着一直往前走。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Okay. Exit Metro, turn right, turn left, then go straight ahead?
dialogue.zh: 好的。出地铁，右转，左转，然后一直往前走？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. My apartment is near a coffee shop.
dialogue.zh: 对。我的公寓在一家咖啡店附近。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Okay. See you soon!

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Anna, Which coffee shop? There are three coffee shops.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，哪家咖啡店？这里有三家咖啡店。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, my apartment is across from a big department store.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我的公寓在一家大百货商店对面。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: A big department store? Ah, I see it!
dialogue.zh: 一家大百货商店？啊，我看到了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ashley! Over here! It’s Anna!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I love having my friends over. Come on!
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢请朋友来家里。来吧！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Great!
